doctrine: Closed language = OMG SysML v2 textual grammar intersected with what the pinned SysON round-trips. Introspect, never invent. See docs/explanations/product/closed-language-compilation.md.

specification.name: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) v2 textual notation
specification.scope: DefinitionElement, UsageElement, AnnotatingElement, Package, LibraryPackage, Import, Alias, filter, Dependency, and KerML literals / operator / feature-reference expressions. KerML membership internals (OwningMembership, FeatureMembership, FeatureTyping, FeatureValue, VariantMembership, …) are not kinds an author writes and are omitted.
